commands.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 2141d6f41816f70997df42b54bcc85b2c72a92c8
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, time, re
def adb(*args, timeout=35):
    return subprocess.run(["adb",*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
devices=adb("devices","-l")
usb=[]
for line in devices.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
    parts=line.split()
    if len(parts)>=2 and parts[1]=="device" and ("usb:" in line or (":" not in parts[0] and not parts[0].startswith("emulator-"))):
        usb.append(parts[0])
if len(usb)!=1:raise SystemExit("NO_UNIQUE_USB_DEVICE")
serial=usb[0]
def shell(*args,timeout=35):
    return adb("-s",serial,"shell",*args,timeout=timeout)
model=shell("getprop","ro.product.model").stdout.strip()
if model!="SM-S906B":raise SystemExit("WRONG_TARGET_MODEL")
res=shell("cmd","package","resolve-activity","--brief","-a","android.intent.action.MAIN","-c","android.intent.category.LAUNCHER","io.blueeye")
print("RESOLVE_ACTIVITY_OK",res.returncode==0)
print("EXPECTED_ACTIVITY", "io.blueeye/.MainActivity" in res.stdout or "io.blueeye.MainActivity" in res.stdout)
launch=shell("am","start","-n","io.blueeye/.MainActivity")
info=(launch.stdout+" "+launch.stderr)
print("EXPLICIT_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_COMMAND_OK",launch.returncode==0 and not re.search(r"Error:|Exception|not found",info,re.I))
print("LAUNCH_DIAGNOSTIC",info.strip().splitlines()[-2:] if info else [])
time.sleep(4)
process=shell("pidof","io.blueeye")
print("PROCESS_RUNNING_AFTER_4S",bool(process.stdout.strip()))
focus=shell("dumpsys","activity","activities")
focused="io.blueeye" in "\n".join(x for x in focus.stdout.splitlines() if "mResumed" in x or "topResumedActivity" in x or "mFocusedApp" in x)
print("BLUEEYE_RESUMED",focused)
if not process.stdout.strip():
    lines=shell("logcat","-d","-t","350","-s","AndroidRuntime:E","ActivityTaskManager:E",timeout=45).stdout.splitlines()
    extracted=[ln for ln in lines if ("io.blueeye" in ln or "FATAL EXCEPTION" in ln or "Process:" in ln or "Exception:" in ln)]
    print("RUNTIME_FATAL_SUMMARY", [re.sub(r"([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}","[redacted]",ln[:250]) for ln in extracted[-9:]])
print("DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE")
